title: The Kyoto, in Sound Podcast
author: SJF
description: The Kyoto, in Sound Podcast is an immersive journey into the everyday soundscapes of Japan’s ancient capital. Each episode begins as a conversation with a local where I ask them to share their favourite sound from Kyoto. I then weave their memories and reflections with field recordings captured on location. From moss-covered shrines to covered shopping streets at dawn, you’ll hear Kyoto as if you were walking beside me. You're invited to notice the small details that make this city unforgettable.
